name: Levaloch

generalAbilities.name: Hellstrider
generalAbilities.description:
A levaloch ignores the effects of non-magical difficult terrain. They take no damage from caltrops or from damaging terrain that deals physical, acid, or cold damage.

A levaloch can move through liquids up to 5 feet deep at their full Speed.

savenote: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

defensiveAbilities.name: Phalanx Fighter
defensiveAbilities.description:
All devils of equal or lower level adjacent to a levaloch gain a +1 circumstance bonus to their AC as the levaloch shields them from harm.

Effect: Phalanx Fighter

defensiveAbilities.name: Stable Stance
defensiveAbilities.description: A levaloch gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their Fortitude DC against being Shoved and to other saving throws to resist being moved against their will.

offensiveAbilities.name: Barbed Net
offensiveAbilities.description:
When a levaloch hits a creature with their barbed net, the net wraps around the target, which becomes Clumsy 1 and takes a -10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds. If the Strike was a critical success, the target is also Immobilized.

When a creature Escapes, or if the Strike misses, the net crumbles into rust.

Each time a creature attempts to Escape, it takes 1d6 Slashing Damage damage from the net's barbs, regardless of whether the attempt succeeds.

Effect: Barbed Net

offensiveAbilities.name: Forge Weapon
offensiveAbilities.description:
A levaloch reforges part of their barbed iron substance into a new +1 Striking trident or barbed net. Their previous trident crumbles to rust.

When the levaloch is destroyed, any tridents or barbed nets they created crumble to rust.

offensiveAbilities.name: Merciless Thrust
offensiveAbilities.description: When a levaloch hits a creature that has the Clumsy, Enfeebled, Immobilized, or Restrained conditions with a melee trident Strike, the Strike deals an additional 2d6 damage.

recallKnowledge: Arcana or Crafting or Religion, DC 23
